runtimeEvidence.source: dev:pipeline_position operator-api route/servingRuntimes read during sampling
runtimeEvidence.isolation: Separate port/process/checkout, shared database and workspace

limitations: Request counts measure reads actually observed in two 300-second windows; no improvement or implementation acceptance is claimed.
Two subscribers are separate browser contexts; this does not test same-document useSyncQuery deduplication.
API failures were retained only up to20 perpage; retained failure counts are bounded evidence, not total error counts.
Startup excluded by per-endpoint mount response witnesses plus30s warmup; target response status was not required to be successful.
This covers the three F1 route surfaces only, not all30 census files or routine cost/no-op/staleness measurements.
